description: This file implements the 'BwrmCpoMatchPath' function, which is a method to match server page paths within the BroadWay Web Resource Manager component. It contains logic to compare provided root and page paths with the object's stored paths to determine if they match.

methods.name: BOOL BwrmCpoMatchPath(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * root_path,char * page_path)
methods.description: Compares the given root and page paths with the object's stored paths to determine if they match, returning TRUE if they do not match, FALSE otherwise.
